features.name: recency_scaled
features.description: Min-max scaled recency of the last donation, normalized to [0, 1] for linear SVM compatibility.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, bounded continuous feature that prevents large recency values from dominating the SVM margin.

features.name: frequency_log_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed and scaled frequency of donations to handle right-skewness and provide a smooth linear feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme frequency outliers, creating a more stable linear projection.

features.name: time_scaled
features.description: Min-max scaled time since the first donation, normalized to [0, 1].
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the time feature is on the same scale as other normalized features, aiding SVM convergence.

features.name: donation_frequency_rate
features.description: Average number of donations per month since the first donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the intensity of the donor's behavior over their entire known history.

features.name: recency_to_time_ratio
features.description: Ratio of recency to total time, indicating how recently the donor was active relative to their entire tenure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized measure of recent engagement relative to the donor's lifecycle.

features.name: active_tenure
features.description: The active donation period in months, calculated as the difference between time since first donation and time since last donation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates the actual window of time during which the donor was actively making donations.

features.name: donations_per_active_month
features.description: Donation rate calculated only over the active tenure period.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a more accurate measure of donation frequency by excluding the inactive period after the last donation.

features.name: volume_log
features.description: Log-transformed total volume of blood donated to provide a continuous severity measure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses the large range of monetary/volume values into a smooth, linear-friendly scale.

features.name: recent_activity_boost
features.description: Weighted composite feature that highlights frequent donors who have also donated very recently (within 3 months).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a non-linear interaction term that linear SVM can use to separate highly engaged recent donors.

features.name: long_term_loyalty
features.description: Weighted composite feature capturing the donation rate of long-term donors (active for 24 months or more).
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to assign specific weights to the behavior of established, long-term donors.

features.name: frequency_time_interaction
features.description: Normalized geometric mean of frequency and time, providing an approximate linear projection of overall donor engagement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the synergistic effect of donating frequently over a long period in a single smooth feature.

features.name: donor_engagement_assessment
features.description: Semantic assessment of the donor's overall engagement and reliability based on their recency, frequency, and total time of donations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear evaluation of donor behavior that complements the linear formula features.
